canDo: Targeted repair of error patterns in main idea, details, negation, opinion and so on.
review: No random drilling; choose material by error tag.
input: 4 sets of short listening and reading questions each + review.
output: For each text/set, write down the evidence and the cause of the error.
checkpoint: Stop only when the same type of error has not appeared for two sets in a row.
challenge: Today’s challenge: targeted repair by error tag. If you often lose marks on negation, find an article on TV5MONDE Apprendre B1 and circle every negative structure (ne… plus, ne… que, aucun, sans); if you often get opinion questions wrong, circle every opinion and contrast marker (selon, pourtant, en revanche, certes). Finally write 3 sentences in your own words, “What this article is really saying is…”, and check them against the text.
